company.name: Short Stay
company.shortDescription: Short Stay is a full-service hospitality provider specializing in contemporary spaces in Dubai's most prestigious neighborhoods.
company.description: Short Stay Vacation Homes is a Dubai-based company that manages short-term rental properties for owners. It handles services such as property listings, bookings, and guest support for apartments and villas rented on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis. The company works with platforms like Airbnb and Booking.com and operates under Dubai’s holiday home regulations. Revenue is generated through a share of rental income from managed properties.
